findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "sparka_presentation_delete" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Permanently deletes a presentation and ends its live session if one is running. Results of past sessions stay readable with `sparka_results_get` by `session_id`…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "sparka_presentation_save" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
